Logs that happen by background workers and timers or automated processes are especially problematic. And we already log errors. Unix: `no news is good news`.

discussion_comments.comment_body:
```
function Queue:log(handler, formatstring, ...)
  local message = "[" .. (self.log_tag or "") .. "] queue " .. self.name .. ": " .. formatstring
  if select('#', ...) > 0 then
    return handler(string.format(message, unpack({...})))
  else
    return handler(message)
  end
end
```

log_debug is a wrapper of Queue:log, which has attached queue's identifier in the log.
